meta.name: saudi-arabia-grc
meta.description: Saudi Arabia Governance, Risk & Compliance advisor — a compliance router that first determines WHICH Saudi regulations apply (NCA ECC-2:2024, Saudi PDPL, NCA Cloud Cybersecurity Controls, SAMA Cyber Security Framework, CST cloud framework, DCC/OTCC/TCC), then guides framework-specific compliance. Use for any Saudi Arabia / KSA compliance question: NCA Essential Cybersecurity Controls, SDAIA and the Personal Data Protection Law (نظام حماية البيانات الشخصية), PDPL breach notification and data transfers, SAMA compliance for banks/insurers/fintechs, cloud data residency in the Kingdom, CST CSP registration, government/CNI cybersecurity obligations, market-entry compliance ("expanding to Saudi Arabia"), gap assessments, and mapping Saudi requirements to ISO 27001 / NIST CSF / SOC 2. Trigger for any KSA, Riyadh, Vision 2030 compliance, NCA, SDAIA, SAMA, or Saudi data protection question even if no framework is named.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 判断适用的沙特法规并引导合规落地
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在沙特开展业务或准备满足沙特监管要求
copy.tagline_en: Identify which Saudi regulations apply and follow compliance guidance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle Saudi regulatory compliance or market entry

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先判断你在沙特适用的具体法规(如 NCA、SDAIA、SAMA、CST),再给出对应合规建议。它会产出适用法规清单、差距评估表、PDPL 违规通知操作、市场进入路线图,并把沙特要求映射到 ISO 27001/NIST/SOC 2,且始终注明监管机构和文号。
howto.when: 当用户提到 KSA/沙特合规、NCA、SDAIA、SAMA 等关键词,或询问市场准入、“扩展至沙特”、差距评估等沙特监管问题时触发,即使未指明具体框架。

say.text: 我们是一家沙特银行,我们适用哪些合规框架?
say.note: 会先列出适用矩阵,再按 SAMA 和 NCA 给建议。

say.text: 沙特发生数据泄露,PDPL 违规通知该怎么做?
say.note: 会给出 72 小时内向 SDAIA 平台通知的步骤。

say.text: 我们要进入沙特市场,请给出合规路线图。
say.note: 会按 PDPL、牌照、ECC、云驻留等逐步规划。
